headers.value: default-src 'self'; base-uri 'self'; object-src 'none'; form-action 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' data: https://fonts.gstatic.com; img-src 'self' data: blob: https:; connect-src 'self' https://*.supabase.co wss://*.supabase.co; frame-ancestors 'self' https://forgelink-portal.vercel.app https://*.forgelink.co; upgrade-insecure-requests

//: Belt and braces. These headers are also declared as Nitro route rules in vite.config.ts, and that is the copy that reaches a visitor: this project builds through the Build Output API, where Vercel routes from .vercel/output/config.json rather than from here. security-headers.test.ts asserts the two agree. No JSONC comments: Snyk's importer parses this as strict JSON and skips the file if it finds any.
